title: Origin story: Orpheus
description: Orpheus was the son of the Muse Calliope, given a lyre by Apollo. His music charmed beasts, trees, and stones. When his bride Eurydice died of a serpent bite, he descended into Hades and sang so movingly that the pitiless gods wept and granted her return — on condition he not look back until they reached the surface.
